description: Source code for a custom test reporter class 'ListReporter' used in Playwright testing framework, responsible for displaying test progress and results in terminal environments.

classes.name: ListReporter
classes.description: A terminal-based test reporter class that displays real-time test progress, handling output, test steps, and results formatting.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, outputs starting message.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test, assigns index, and displays test title.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error output from tests.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test step, displays step info if configured.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step, updates display with step duration and errors.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles pausing of a test, displays pause message.

methods.name: _updateTestLine
methods.description: Updates the display line for a test based on its result.

methods.name: _updateOrAppendLine
methods.description: Updates existing line or appends a new line in terminal output.

methods.name: _appendLine
methods.description: Appends a new line to terminal output.

methods.name: _updateLine
methods.description: Updates a specific line in terminal output.

methods.name: _updateLineForTTY
methods.description: Handles line update in TTY environments using escape sequences.

methods.name: _testPrefix
methods.description: Generates prefix string for test output line.

methods.name: _retrySuffix
methods.description: Returns suffix string if test is a retry.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles end of test run, outputs final epilogue.
